mapper.select: select rule.rule_label from b_marketing_customer_rule rule left join b_marketing_customer_rule_mapping mapping on rule.id = mapping.rule_id where mapping.api_code = #{apiCode} and mapping.is_delete = 0

select customer.cid as cid ,customer.api_code as apiCode ,rule.condition_info as conditionInfo from b_customer_rule rule join b_marketing_customer customer on rule.customer_id = customer.id where rule.rule_id = #{ruleId} and rule.is_del = '1' and customer.status = '1'
mapper.insert: insert into b_marketing_customer_rule_mapping (api_code, create_time, rule_id) values (#{apiCode}, now(), #{ruleId})
mapper.select: select id from b_marketing_customer_rule where rule_label = #{ruleLabel} limit 1;
